name: Bay-17 Aquaculture Sector
description: Dense shellfish and finfish aquaculture corridor. Highly susceptible to coastal runoff and summer thermal stratification.

name: South Coast Fishery Sector 4
description: High-volume artisanal trawling zone bordering seasonal upwelling boundaries.

name: Deep Marine Trench Area B
description: Deep pelagic zone characterized by high current stability and low anthropogenic nutrient loading.
